title: Kingdom Hearts IV will launch in late 2027 and shows the world of Coco in a new trailer
summary: Square Enix presented an extensive Kingdom Hearts IV trailer at D23, confirmed its 2027 release window, and the first world inspired by Pixar's Coco.

title: Kingdom Hearts will have an original anime series on Disney+ and Disney Channel
summary: Disney and Square Enix announced an animated adaptation of Kingdom Hearts, still without a specific date, with Tetsuya Nomura inviting fans to imagine possibilities.

title: The Simpsons creator hints at the return of the Hit & Run video game
summary: Matt Groening hinted that the franchise's classic driving game will return in some form, although the current showrunner qualified it.

title: Stalker 2 will receive a major free 2.0 update with atmosphere and A-Life improvements
summary: Stalker 2's 2.0 update will add functional fog, improvements to the A-Life system, and a less hostile world, in addition to preparing an expansion.

title: Former Square Enix executive argues that removing discs from PlayStation would make games cheaper
summary: The debate over a disc-less PlayStation resurges after statements from a former Square Enix executive about possible price drops on the PS Store.

title: Video game media share their weekend play sessions
summary: Several publications gather in their weekly articles the games their editors are playing during the weekend.

title: Saber CEO apologizes for replacing a writer with ChatGPT and then lashes out at a critic
summary: The controversy over the use of AI at Saber Interactive ended with public apologies, followed by an attack by the CEO on a Portal writer who mocked him.

title: The Witcher 3 designer explains how they got NPCs to react realistically
summary: The Witcher 3 developers recall the difficulties of convincing players that the NPC simulation was not a trick.

title: Marvel shows the Avengers: Doomsday trailer and reveals the X-Men cast
summary: New footage from Avengers: Doomsday shows Robert Downey Jr. as Doom, while the cast of the X-Men reboot is confirmed with Adam Driver as the villain.
